result.sql: WITH lowest_bdcs AS (SELECT bdc FROM holdings_v WHERE is_debt = 1 AND price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bdc ORDER BY AVG(price) ASC LIMIT 10) SELECT h.bdc, h.identifier, h.price FROM holdings_v h JOIN lowest_bdcs b ON h.bdc = b.bdc WHERE h.is_debt = 1 AND h.price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.price ASC LIMIT 20
